svg.aria-label: A ship-to-ship cryogenic propellant transfer interface as a test article on a plinth: two insulated tank end sections face each other dome to dome, docked through a collar and a latched ring with umbilical plates on top. Below, each dome's sump boss feeds a vacuum-jacketed line with bellows, a flow meter and an isolation valve to a quick-disconnect; the lit main transfer line runs between the two quick-disconnects. Each tank also carries a vent line with a relief valve, a pressurisation line to the umbilical, and a mass-gauging sensor.
